_comment: Canonical MCP ToolAnnotations for Brutor's own system MCP servers, one section per server. Both planes define these tools (core: services/system_server.rs, services/search_server.rs; control plane: app/constants/system_server.py + app/database/seed_system_servers.py) and tests in both pin them to this file. The gateway classifies risk (autonomy levels, deny_tool_risk, evidence) from the control plane's stored copy; agents see the core's live tools/list. An unannotated tool is side-effecting, so a read without hints is blocked by approval_required / restricted autonomy. skills__run_script is NOT read-only and deliberately claims no destructiveHint=false: a skill script can do anything its sandbox allows.
